title: Dog Laugh
blurb: Dogs really do have a laugh — a breathy, rhythmic panting huff that behavioural researchers have recorded and even played back to shelter dogs to measurably calm them down. This clip has the classic version, and it is uncanny: it sits right on the line between an innocent pant and open mockery. Which is, inevitably, how the internet uses it. Play it whenever somebody falls over and is definitely, definitely fine.
origin: A recording of the breathy panting sound identified as canine laughter.
